name: patch_script
title: patch_script
description: Edits part of an existing script without rewriting the whole file. Prefer this over attach_script_safe for any change to a script that already has content: attach_script_safe replaces the entire file with what you send, so anything you did not reproduce exactly is silently deleted. On a 300-line script that is destructive. The patched result is compiled in memory before anything is written, so a patch that would not parse is refused and the file on disk is left untouched. Always read_script first — replace_function needs a real function name, and replace_text matches exactly, including indentation (GDScript uses tabs).

path.description: Script to edit. It must already exist.

operation.description: replace_function swaps one whole function, found by name and bounded by indentation — the safest option, and the one to reach for by default. append adds to the end of the file, for a new function. replace_text is a literal find/replace for edits that are not function-shaped.

function.description: replace_function only: the name of the function to replace.

source.description: replace_function: the complete replacement including the 'func' line. append: the text to add.

find.description: replace_text only: the exact text to find, whitespace included.

replace.description: replace_text only: what to put there. Empty string deletes the matched text.

replace_all.description: replace_text only: allow more than one match. Without this, an ambiguous match is an error rather than a coin flip.

dry_run.description: Build and compile the patched result, report whether it parses, write nothing.

replaced_lines.description: replace_function: the line range that was swapped out.

occurrences.description: replace_text: how many matches were replaced.

errors.file_not_found: No file there. Use attach_script_safe to create a new script.
errors.unknown_operation: operation must be replace_function, append or replace_text.
errors.function_not_found: No function by that name; call read_script to see what exists.
errors.text_not_found: The find text does not appear. Whitespace must match exactly.
errors.ambiguous_match: The find text appears more than once. Add surrounding context or pass replace_all.
errors.patch_would_not_compile: The result does not parse. Nothing was written; the file is unchanged.
errors.no_change: The patch produced an identical file.
